verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents working on repositories, so querying generated repository documentation is a fair question for this kind of tool. However, the evidence shows no capability to generate or query documentation for arbitrary public or private repositories. The closest items are an ad-hoc agent prompt that summarizes the local checkout and a Ledger Wiki profile for storing Markdown knowledge, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query generated documentation for any public or private repository
